sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Find all green blocks and their positions
seg = current_frame.segmentation
green_blocks = []
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'N':
        rows = [p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
        cols = [p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
        center_row = (min(rows) + max(rows)) // 2
        center_col = (min(cols) + max(cols)) // 2
        green_blocks.append((center_row, center_col, n['pixels']))
        print(f"Green block at row {center_row}, col {center_col}, pixels={n['pixels']}")

print(f"\nTotal green blocks: {len(green_blocks)}")

# Collect all green blocks using MOUSE
for row, col, _ in green_blocks:
    action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': row, 'col': col}])

# Check result
seg = current_frame.segmentation
green_count = sum(1 for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N')
print(f"\nAfter collection: {green_count} green blocks remaining")
print(f"Level completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
